name: Kimchi Fried Rice

cookwares.name: large skillet or wok; nonstick skillet

ingredients.name: cool cooked white rice, preferably a day old

instructions.primary_message: Pour 2 tablespoons of the oil into a large skillet or wok and turn the heat to medium. When oil starts to shimmer, add the kimchi. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the kimchi is heated through, about 2 minutes. Add the butter and the red pepper paste. Stir well until both are incorporated.

Add the rice, breaking up any clumps with a wooden spoon. Stir until it is evenly mixed in with the kimchi. Pour the sesame oil on top of this mixture. Spread the rice and kimchi out as much as possible in an even layer, and let cook for a few minutes until it gets a little crispy on the bottom. Turn off the heat, and divide the mixture between four bowls.

Pour the remaining one tablespoon of oil into a nonstick skillet set over medium-high heat. When shimmering, crack in the eggs, cover the skillet, and cook until the whites have set. When each is done, use a spatula and set one egg on top of each bowl of rice. Garnish with the crushed seaweed, scallions, and black pepper. Serve immediately.

schema_metadata.keywords: Dinner Tonight, fried rice, kimchi, put an egg on it, quick, rice

description: Kimchi fried rice is endlessly adaptable and this version takes a page from bibimbap and is topped with a whole, golden-yolked egg. It's a perfect, easy weeknight meal.
author: Nick Kindelsperger
